build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, editable install with pip install -e '.[dev]'
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, tests in tests/ directory, class-based test organization
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3.12 -m pytest tests/ -v --tb=short and confirm all tests pass. 2. Run python3.12 -c 'import agentwork' to confirm imports work.
environment_constraints: Using python3.12 via pyenv. No Docker daemon available for container tests. Network available for pip installs.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: tools as decorated functions, presets as factory functions returning Agent instances, pydantic models for data, never-fail execution returning TaskResult

key_patterns.presets: Each preset is a module in agentwork/presets/ with @tool-decorated functions and a factory function (e.g., OfficeAgent()) that returns Agent(name=..., tools=[...], capabilities=[...])
key_patterns.tools: @tool decorator from agentwork.tools.decorators wraps functions into Tool instances with retry_attempts, fallback, etc.
key_patterns.agent: Agent class in agentwork/core/agent.py - has name, description, tools, capabilities. execute() never raises, returns TaskResult.
key_patterns.fleet: FleetManager registers agents, dispatches tasks via TaskRouter that matches by tool_name or capability.
key_patterns.pipeline: Pipeline chains tools sequentially (output->input) or in parallel. Returns TaskResult.
key_patterns.server: create_app(agent) returns FastAPI app with /execute, /result/{task_id}, /tools, /health. LRUResultStore for task tracking.
key_patterns.engine: TaskPlanner creates plans with Steps (DAG), TaskExecutor runs them respecting dependencies.
key_patterns.init_exports: All public classes exported from agentwork/__init__.py and listed in __all__

directory_structure: agentwork/ is the package root. Sub-packages: core/ (Agent, Result, Context, Exceptions), tools/ (Tool, decorators, registry), engine/ (Pipeline, Planner, Executor), fleet/ (FleetManager, Pool, Router), presets/ (Office, Marketing, Sales, Digital, Entertainment), resilience/ (Retry, Fallback, CircuitBreaker, Timeout), scheduler/ (Scheduler, Worker, Triggers), server/ (FastAPI app, middleware). Tests in tests/.
